title: Catalytic wet air oxidation of organics-laden wastewater: in situ catalyst regeneration and process scale-up
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,1623-1635
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00745C, Paper
Rahul Gupta, Kaushik Basak, Nishith Verma
Scalable Fe–Ag bimetal-synthesized carbon nanofibers (CNFs) supported on activated carbon beads enabled a high-efficiency cWAO of industrial wastewater (COD ∼120 000 mg L−1), with 99% COD reduction, in situ regeneration, and economic viability.
